plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Kymata outdoor WiFi RF amplifiers (enterprise PEN 60429, KYMATA-AMP-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports internal temperature, 5 V rail voltage, RF output power, the alarm status and the RF board power-fault flag.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the Kymata outdoor WiFi RF amplifier in degrees Celsius, read from KYMATA-AMP-MIB temperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.60429.1.3.10) with no scaling. Values outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: kymata_supply_voltage_volts
metrics.description: 5 V rail voltage of the Kymata amplifier in volts, from KYMATA-AMP-MIB voltage5V (1.3.6.1.4.1.60429.1.3.11, millivolts) divided by 1000 in the collector. Values less than or equal to 0 V or greater than 10 V are dropped.

metrics.name: kymata_rf_output_dbm
metrics.description: RF output power of the Kymata amplifier in dBm, from KYMATA-AMP-MIB rfOut (1.3.6.1.4.1.60429.1.3.12, 0.01 dBm) divided by 100 in the collector. Values outside -60 to 40 dBm are dropped.

metrics.name: kymata_alarm_state
metrics.description: Kymata amplifier alarm state from KYMATA-AMP-MIB alarmStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.60429.1.3.1): noAlarm(0) maps to 1 (normal); apAlarm(1), lowOutputPower(2), pcbPowerFault(3) and highTemperature(4) map to 2 (abnormal). Other values are dropped.

metrics.name: kymata_pcb_power_state
metrics.description: RF board power-fault flag from KYMATA-AMP-MIB pcbPowerProblem (1.3.6.1.4.1.60429.1.3.16): absent(0) maps to 1 (normal); present(1) maps to 2 (abnormal). Other values are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
